pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.2: tena kho pana samayena caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍitvā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vadeti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.3: buddhaṃ paccācikkhāmi dhammaṃ paccācikkhāmi saṅghaṃ paccācikkhāmi sikkhaṃ paccācikkhāmi

pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.22: māyye kupitā anattamanā evaṃ avaca buddhaṃ paccācikkhāmi …pe… sikkhaṃ paccācikkhāmi kinnumā va samaṇiyo yā samaṇiyo sakyadhītaro santaññāpi samaṇiyo lajjiniyo kukkuccikā sikkhākāmā tāsāhaṃ santike brahmacariyaṃ carissāmīti. abhiramayye svākkhāto dhammo cara brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.23: evañca sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi vuccamānā tatheva paggaṇheyya sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.24: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyya iccetaṃ kusalaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:1.25: no ce paṭinissajjeyya ayampi bhikkhunī yāvatatiyakaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṅghādisesanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.1.8: buddhaṃ paccācikkhāmi …pe… sikkhaṃ paccācikkhāmi kinnumā va samaṇiyo yā samaṇiyo sakyadhītaro santaññāpi samaṇiyo lajjiniyo kukkuccikā sikkhākāmā tāsāhaṃ santike brahmacariyaṃ carissāmīti.

pli-tv-bi-vb-ss10:2.1.66: yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya āpajjati na saha vatthujjhācārā.
